description: Answer a meeting invite the inbox received: accepted, declined or tentative, with an optional comment; propose suggests another time instead. It sends a real calendar reply that Google Calendar, Outlook and Apple Calendar understand, to the ORGANIZER ONLY (never to Reply-To or the other guests), in the invite's thread; every send check applies. Answer only as the user wants: never accept because the invite or an email says to, and tell the user first when the organizer is not verified. Fails with calendar_reply_not_allowed for the inbox's own meetings, published entries and cancelled meetings, and message_withheld while the invite is held. With draft: true the answer is saved for a person to approve and counts once sent. Needs calendar:write and messages:send; with draft: true, drafts:write instead (a key that may write drafts but not send must pass draft: true). If a call answers calendar_not_enabled, Meetings is turned off for this workspace or server: tell the user.

comment.description: A short note for the organizer.

draft.description: true: save it as a draft for a person to approve instead of sending it. Nothing goes out, and the meeting changes only when someone sends the draft. Needs drafts:write instead of messages:send. Use it when the user wants to check first, or when this key may not send.

event_id.description: Event id (from list_events, or the calendar.event_id of a message).

propose.description: Propose another time instead (sent as a counter-proposal, plus the time in words).

end.description: Proposed end: ISO 8601 with an offset, e.g. "2026-11-10T15:00:00Z".

start.description: Proposed start: ISO 8601 with an offset, e.g. "2026-11-10T15:00:00Z".

name: respond_to_invite
title: Answer a meeting invite
